newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr strengthens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr strengthens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr strengthened marginally against the dollar, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said on Monday.
It posted the birr at a mean rate of 6.38 against the dollar, versus 6.40 last week.
The bank said that after the currency auction on November 2, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the period November 4 to 10, would be 6.38 to the dollar.

The bank quoted the birr against the pound at a mean rate of 10.3777 from 10.4102 last week. Against the yen, the birr was traded at 0.056256 from 0.056432 and at 4.2220 against the mark, from 4.2353 last week.
